best_for: PC gamers who claim Epic's free games or play Fortnite and Rocket League, and Unreal Engine users who install the engine through Epic.
description:
The Epic Games Launcher is Epic Games' desktop app for your games. You sign in, then install your games and start them from your library.

Epic's preview version adds more. You can start a party and chat with friends without leaving the launcher, pin your favorite games and apps to the top bar, and hide games you no longer play. Sort and filter your library by platform or genre, see failed and scheduled downloads next to active ones, and check an activity feed for playtime, updates and installs since you last played.

points.title: Store, library and Unreal in one
points.text: The launcher holds the Epic Games Store, your game library, and a Develop section for Unreal Engine. The app itself is free to download.

points.title: A new launcher is in preview
points.text: Epic is testing a rebuilt launcher that starts faster, shows live download speeds and queues, and adds grid views and collections. Installing it removes the old one, while purchases, installed games, cloud saves and progress carry over. Some social and account features from the old launcher are still missing.

points.title: Apple silicon only for the preview
points.text: The preview needs macOS 12 or newer on an M1 chip or later; Intel Macs are not supported. The Mac build listed here is one universal installer that needs macOS 13 or later, and only the current release is listed.

points.title: Linux is in the preview too
points.text: The preview adds a .deb for Ubuntu 22.04 or Debian 12 and newer, and an AppImage for Fedora 43 or newer. Many games are Windows-only and need a compatibility layer, so check each game before you rely on it. This site does not list a Linux build.

points.title: Online first
points.text: You need an internet connection to set the launcher up and for its online features. Offline mode works only for eligible games you have already installed.

points.title: Windows details
points.text: The preview asks for 64-bit Windows 10 or 11, a Core i3 or Ryzen 3, 4 GB of RAM and 700 MB of disk. The Windows MSI listed here is x64 and installs for all users, and the listing keeps 22 versions.
